candidates.review_note: Represent the matrix with right/down linked cells and fixed dummy boundaries. Rectangle exchange changes only outgoing pointers on the four borders. Collect both complete border lists before any mutation, so later walks cannot follow already-swapped links. The non-touching guarantee keeps exchanged interfaces distinct; final row traversals read unchanged cell values in their new positions.

Columns are independent short partizan number games. Recursively enumerate exactly the legal left/white and right/black moves, including eating opposite pieces, and assign the simplest dyadic number strictly between option bounds. Memoization covers at most3^8 column states; exact rational addition combines columns without rounding. Positive total favors the first player, while zero or negative favors Snuke.

For height h above the highest point, the minimum radius is max(rho_i*h/(h-z_i)). Each point imposes a convex volume factor rho_i^2*h^3/(h-z_i)^2, minimized at3z_i; their maximum is convex and no optimum exceeds3max(z). Ternary search this domain, then recompute the enclosing radius and output height/radius to the required precision. Axis points impose only the minimum height; exclude their zero radial requirement from radius division, so a tip touching an axis point does not divide0/0.

Until the two taken regions meet, Takahashi takes a suffix and Aoki takes a contiguous block of globally closest values. Binary-search the largest k for which the k closest cards avoid the top k suffix, using the distance to its smallest card and lower-value tie preference. Locate that closest block by binary search. At collision there is either no gap or one Takahashi card; the remaining smaller prefix is then taken alternately and answered from parity prefix sums.

Enumerate all3^5 resident-type assignments and both day/night states. Each utterance must equal the truth-telling status of its speaker; lying predicates refer to the subject under the same assignment. Retain all consistent models, then report only facts common to every model in person order followed by time. Distinguish contradiction from lack of a determinate fact and parse optional negation/self-reference.
